result.quote: There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son
result.reason: The key reasonably paraphrases the covenant and oath, but the question does not say “immediately before” and presents these actions as something the commanders “must” do, whereas the verse narrates what Jehoiada did with or to them. Being brought into the house of the LORD is also an action occurring before they saw the king’s son. The wording also needs articles: “the commanders” and “the king’s son.”
